title: Hazor
lead: The largest Canaanite city, in the north above the Sea of Galilee. Joshua burned it, Deborah and Barak fought its king Jabin, and Solomon and Ahab rebuilt it (Joshua 11; Judges 4; 1 Kings 9:15).

sections.b: Jabin king of Hazor led the northern alliance against Joshua, who burned the city as "the head of all these kingdoms" (Joshua 11:1–13). Hazor was given to Naphtali (Joshua 19:36). In Judges another Jabin "king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor" oppressed Israel until Deborah and Barak defeated his general Sisera (Judges 4–5). Solomon fortified Hazor with Megiddo and Gezer (1 Kings 9:15), and the Assyrian king Tiglath-pileser III took it in 732 BC (2 Kings 15:29). Its huge ruins are among the most important excavations in Israel.
